sources.entry: Sequel Ace - The maintained "sequel" to the longtime macOS tool Sequel Pro. [![Open-Source Software][oss icon]](https://github.com/Sequel-Ace/Sequel-Ace)
Sequel Ace - Sequel Ace is a fast, easy-to-use Mac database management application for working with MySQL & MariaDB databases.

summary.one_liner: Sequel Ace is a free, open-source macOS app for managing MySQL and MariaDB databases, positioned as the maintained successor to Sequel Pro.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Sequel Ace as a Mac database management application for MySQL and MariaDB, forked from Sequel Pro. It supports macOS 13.5 and later on Intel and Apple Silicon, and MySQL 5.7+ or MariaDB 10.0+. It includes a built-in Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets AI agents such as Claude Code and Cursor query databases through the app's existing connections. The MCP server is off by default, listens on localhost only, and is read-only unless the user changes that in Preferences. The README also covers migrating saved connections from Sequel Pro, and points to older releases for unsupported macOS or MySQL versions.
use_cases: manage MySQL databases on a Mac
work with MariaDB databases from macOS
migrate saved connections from Sequel Pro
let AI agents query a local database read-only
install a database GUI via Mac App Store or Homebrew
notable: Successor to Sequel Pro, forked from it and maintained separately
Built-in MCP server for AI agent access, off by default and read-only by default
Available on the Mac App Store, plus a community Homebrew cask
Beta builds install side-by-side with the App Store release under a different name
caveats: Requires macOS 13.5 or later for current releases; older macOS versions need previous releases with no guaranteed support
Supports only MySQL 5.7+ and MariaDB 10.0+ in current releases; MySQL 5.6 needs version 3.5.2
Homebrew cask is an unofficial community-maintained package
